since_deployment.interpretation: Recorded as-of depth ages; unavailable ages are not zero. No feature reselection or threshold changes.

state_v2_last_24h.interpretation: Recorded as-of depth ages; unavailable ages are not zero. No feature reselection or threshold changes.

paired_diagnostics.interpretation: Sensitivity only: average within each shared entry, then across entries. Overlapping windows remain dependent; no new primary, interval or support claim. Equal minute entry clocks cannot establish a subminute execution or latency advantage.

options_quality.selected_interpretation: Only call/put legs at the recorded interpolation expiries, separately per horizon. Shared legs count once per capture within each horizon; repeated captures and horizons are dependent. Diagnostic reasons describe the retained selection and never replace its frozen eligibility.
options_quality.interpretation: All observed legs, not independent samples. Rejection reasons overlap. No filter change or predictive admission; quote size stays unavailable when absent.

state_v2_progress.interpretation: Block equivalents are not independent samples. Frozen interval and review rules; no automatic promotion.

options_expiry_pilot.interpretation: Repeated horizons and contracts are dependent. A usability gain does not demonstrate predictive skill.

options_30d_pilot.interpretation: Separate prospective maturity experiment. Compare nearest eligible expiries within 45 versus 90 days, with identical leg filters and a 35-day maximum span in both arms. Repeated captures are dependent; usability is not predictive skill.

immediate_books.interpretation: Immediate collector diagnostic, separate from both prospective pilots. Missing and budget-skipped captures are explicit; later sizes never replace original quotes.

source_quality.interpretation: Zero trades and a flat last price are a source-quality anomaly, not proof of an exchange outage. Overlapping windows are not independent. Frozen scores and input eligibility remain unchanged.
